messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — release train is live for the week. We're in a PARTIAL release freeze for infra/runtime changes until Fri 18:00 UTC. App bugfixes that do not touch deploy plumbing or schema are OK with +1 from a service owner.

sam: Clarifying — does the freeze block model swaps and quantization profile changes?

maria: Yes — model swaps (new weights or quantization profiles) are blocked unless you get an explicit freeze-exception. Reason: these regularly change perf and we need a canary window.

kevin: Canary status so far: canary-v2 routing at 8% -> 10% as of 11:12 UTC. No 5xx spikes, but p95 token latency nudged up ~12% on long-seqs.

ci-bot: Deploy finished: inference-service/canary-v2 @ 2026-03-22T11:12:03Z — checks: unit-tests✅, integration✅, smoke📉

maria: Good catch, kevin. Ops: watch tail latency over next 2h. Rollback criteria: p95 > 200ms for two consecutive 10m windows OR error-rate > 0.5%. If either triggers, start rollback and page @oncall.

kevin: Running a lightweight perf run against the 2k seq path now. Will post results in 30m.

alex: If a team needs a freeze-exception, what's the process?

maria: Process: 1) open ticket in #eng-releases-exceptions with PR link + perf evidence; 2) get +1 from product owner; 3) @maria and @sam signoff. Do not ship without the thread.

sam: Noted. Also: reminder to update canary config to include KV-cache warming — small tweak reduces cold-start tail. Example snippet we used:
```
service: inference-api
canary_percent: 10
route: canary-v2
kv_warm: true
```

kevin: Perf run update: 2k seq p95 at +9% (within tolerance), no errors. I'll hold on full rollout until noon UTC.

maria: Thanks. If things look stable at noon we'll bump to 25% and hold for another hour. If any team sees anomalous behaviour, please post here and @oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall: Acknowledged — watching infra metrics (GPU util, NVMe IO, network egress). Will page if tail latency crosses threshold.

maria: Final note — release notes and changelog will be posted to the usual release train doc after we confirm 25% hold. Keep PR descriptions focused on user-visible change and perf/regressions tested. :thumbsup:
